final_critic_line: A city that had survived by keeping its maker asleep learned to ask before it crossed: Nel Vasco proved one room by her son's crooked notch and its tar draught, Dorrit Vane received the people of the edge, and the sixty-one who stayed were told the unknowable truth and allowed to be afraid, while Illuminara held stone and silence without choosing for any of them.
